visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A variety of Japanese izakaya dishes are spread across a wooden table. A small brown and white Chihuahua wearing a brown hoodie sits alertly behind the food. A hand brings a plate with small corn skewers toward the dog. (2) Close-ups of meat skewers being grilled over a charcoal pit; flames flicker and a brush applies a dark glaze. (3) A series of rapid cuts show different skewers: pork wrapped cherry tomatoes, pork with green onions, bacon-wrapped scallops, and glazed intestinal skewers being lifted. (4) A large grilled chicken wing is broken in half by chopsticks, revealing a dense orange meat filling. (5) A triangular rice ball (onigiri) is shown being grilled on the grate and brushed with sauce, then presented with a piece of seaweed on top. (6) A whole squid is grilled, then sliced into rings and served with lemon and seasoning. (7) Clams are shown sizzling in a pan with a butter-based sauce. (8) A wok is tossed with large flames as green vegetables are stir-fried. (9) Two tall glasses containing colorful layered iced drinks and a glass of beer are shown on the table. (10) A refrigerator filled with many varieties of sake and plum wine bottles is shown in a quick pan. (11) The camera pans through the interior of the restaurant, showing wooden tables, gray seating, and posters on the wall. (12) An exterior shot of the restaurant at night shows red lanterns and a white sign with a dog illustration.
